request: Please book me from San Francisco to Denver on December 3; the pavement research panel starts at 2 p.m. Denver time and I have to be there for it.

must_keep.quote: Travelers must purchase the lowest cost airfare whenever possible
must_keep.why: the lowest cost airfare whenever possible

must_keep.quote: Out-of-State Travel: Non-refundable airfare from any carrier is allowed if the fare is less costly than the out-of-state contracted airfare.
must_keep.why: out-of-state: non-refundable from any carrier if less costly than the contract fare

must_keep.quote: The Department of General Services (DGS) has contracted with various airlines for discounted airfare. These fares are available through the Department's Travel Agency for refundable in-state, out-of-state and international flights. Cost savings are achieved with these discounted fares, as they are fully refundable and for travel in either direction of the city pair. See the contract Airline rates within California, Out-of-State, and International for more information.
must_keep.why: DGS contracted refundable fares for in-state, out-of-state and international city pairs

must_keep.quote: YCAL Contract Airfare: Unrestricted airfare with last seat availability. Capacity Controlled Contract Airfare: Capacity controlled as a limited number of seats have been specifically set aside at these rates. These fares are less expensive than YCAL fares and should be used when seats are available. The fares can be upgraded to YCAL when necessary.
must_keep.why: capacity-controlled contract fares before YCAL when seats are available

must_keep.quote: The Division of Resource and Innovation is responsible for administering the approval process for out-of-state travel. Employees with questions regarding the approval process should contact their own program's out-of-state travel coordinator.

distractors.quote: Note: Prices indicated reflect a one-way fare.

design_notes: Southwest lands 13:50, after the 13:30 limit. United's non-refundable 23900 is above its own 22900 capacity-controlled contract fare, so 186-187 do not allow it; the contract fare is the lowest cost airfare that lands in time.
